mentions.name: Neimr
mentions.description: A collaborative naming app with Tinder-style swiping. Users create a survey for baby names, pet names, business names, and more, invite a partner or friends, and the app finds which names everyone agrees on. Built with Flutter + Firebase.
mentions.source_excerpt: - Neimr — a collaborative naming app with Tinder-style swiping. Create a survey for baby names, pet names, business names, etc., invite your partner/friends, and it finds which names you all agree on. Built with Flutter + Firebase.
